_comment: Canonical record of scry contracts that are live on-chain.
foundry's broadcast/ is gitignored (transient gas/tx noise), so a deploy
receipt lives only on whichever machine ran it. This file is the durable
record — update it in the same commit as any broadcast.
An entry here means BROADCAST AND LIVE. Contracts that are written but
unrun (ScryReputation, ScryJobBoard, ScryInsurancePool) are absent on
purpose: run `forge test` before broadcast, then add them here.

SCRY.consumed_by: SCRY_TOKEN — arena, bank, hive, holder_snapshot, holders, munus, pools, holdings (GET /holdings/{wallet})
SCRY.note: The reserve. EXTERNAL AND PRE-EXISTING: fair-launched on a launchpad, not deployed by any script in this repo, which is why it carries no deployer, tx or source (TOKENOMICS.md SCRY, PHASES.md). Recorded here because it is broadcast and live -- it is token1 of the live SCRY/WETH pool -- and because its ABSENCE was the root of the address sprawl: with no durable record to read, seven modules each fell back to os.getenv("SCRY_TOKEN", "0xDa2a..."), an env var whose default is a literal. 72 files in this repo carry that literal. Fixed supply: nothing mints SCRY, so reward pools are funded by explicit public transfer.
SCRY.verified_live: 2026-08-06 — GET /api/pools reports it as token1 of 0xEA8D769eEdEC0eaF19698aEAF4fb3e24f77d7462

ScryNotary.consumed_by: SCRY_NOTARY (meter/ecosystem.config.js) — GET /inscribe, GET /onchain, the augury seed beacon
ScryNotary.note: permissionless, ownerless, holds no funds - notarize(bytes32,string,string) writes a readable label+memo into the event log with on-chain first-seen priority

SpoilsToken:OBOL.note: UNCAPPED by design (cap=0); minter is still the deploy wallet until gardener/granary/rotate. Supply after launch 17,767,650 = 17,650,000 pooled + 17,650 canary + 100,000 Garden seed.

SpoilsToken:MYRRH.note: cap 21,000,000 IMMUTABLE and a lifetime mint budget (_burn never decrements). Supply after launch 2,492,470 = 2,470,000 pooled + 2,470 canary + 20,000 Garden seed.

ScryGarden:MYRRH-OBOL.consumed_by: the farm's pid 0 (gardener phase, not yet deployed)
ScryGarden:MYRRH-OBOL.note: x*y=k, 0.3% fee, opened at exactly 5 OBOL/MYRRH with 100,000 OBOL + 20,000 MYRRH. token0=MYRRH token1=OBOL. SEED total 44,721.359…; 1,000 wei is MINIMUM_LIQUIDITY locked forever (first-depositor guard) and the deploy wallet holds all the rest — removeLiquidity has no owner gate, no timelock.

ScryHarvest:OBOL.note: deployed UNFUNDED and with NO root, which is correct: /api/tokens/claim-root is the empty root and total_committed is 0. Fund before posting a non-empty root, never after.

ScryBank.consumed_by: SCRY_BANK (meter/ecosystem.config.js) + watchtower/bank.config.json bank -> GET /bank, the bank page
ScryBank.note: stake SCRY -> xSCRY. OPENS EMPTY AND MUST STAY EMPTY: enter() reads the pool before pulling the deposit, so while totalSupply()==0 the first depositor of any size redeems the whole balance. TREASURY.md P9's 9M waits on a real stake; status prints NOT SEEDABLE until then. totalSupply read back 0 at broadcast.

ScryFeeSplitter.consumed_by: SCRY_FEE_SPLITTER (meter/ecosystem.config.js) + watchtower/bank.config.json feeSplitter; the mandatory immutable for ScryEidolon / ScrySteleEdition / DeployScryMarket
ScryFeeSplitter.note: the one posted route for every SCRY fee. Split READ BACK OFF CHAIN at broadcast: 0x…dEaD 5000 / ScryBank 4000 / dev wallet 0xb474a952… 1000 (SENTENCES 2026-07-27; prizes take no line, so no escrow exists). operator() = the deploy wallet -> multisig per HELD-KEYS.md. setSplit can repost; fees collected before a repost pay out under the split they were collected under.

ScryCovenant.consumed_by: SCRY_COVENANT (meter/ecosystem.config.js on the deploy box) -> meter/scry_ops.py covenantCount, GET /onchain
ScryCovenant.note: ONE oath text, N wallets. Permissionless, ownerless, holds no funds - gas is the price. Full oath text lands in CovenantOpened so a human reads words on the explorer, not a hash. renounce() is first-class and recorded: memberCount never falls, activeCount does. No constructor args, no operator, nothing to retire.

ScryPact.consumed_by: SCRY_PACT (meter/ecosystem.config.js on the deploy box) -> meter/scry_ops.py pactCount, GET /onchain
ScryPact.note: the bilateral cousin of the covenant: 2+ parties, DIFFERENT obligations, ONE document. Not an escrow (holds no funds), not enforcement (slashes nothing), never a verdict. Full terms + every party's role land in PactProposed. Permissionless, ownerless, free. No constructor args, nothing to retire.

ScryShrine.note: burns only: no grant, no minter, no funds, no way in but offer(). baseStep 100e18 (LAUNCH-DECISIONS.md's 10x redenomination; immutable, no setter). Altar 0 = OBOL 1 point/token, altar 1 = MYRRH 5 points/token, the Book's 5:1 base rate. A rank is a public record and buys nothing - not reputation, not access, not odds. owner() = the deploy wallet, whose only powers are addOffering / setOfferingEnabled / transferOwner.

ScryShrine:DUPLICATE-DEAD.status: DEAD - do not wire, do not verify, do not publish
ScryShrine:DUPLICATE-DEAD.note: A SECOND shrine broadcast by mistake on 2026-07-30: `shrine --arm` was run, its output was truncated by a `head -12` in the pipeline that read it, the broadcast was not seen, and the phase was re-run. Identical bytecode and identical altars to the live one. It holds no funds and never took an offering (totalVotive 0 at the time of writing), but it was a LIVE contract a stranger could have burned real OBOL into for a rank no surface reads - so both altars were closed the same day: setOfferingEnabled(0,false) 0x89edb57f… and setOfferingEnabled(1,false) 0x514891ec…, read back false. offer() now reverts 'altar closed'. It was deliberately NOT submitted for verification — and that turned out not to be ours to decide: Blockscout serves the canonical shrine's source at this address too, by identical-bytecode match (`is_fully_verified` and `is_partially_verified` both read false here, and every external-verifier flag is false, but /api/v2/smart-contracts returns the source). So the intended mitigation of 'leave it unfindable' never held, and the one that actually holds is the one already applied: BOTH ALTARS ARE CLOSED, so offer() reverts.
ScryShrine:DUPLICATE-DEAD.verified: bytecode-match only — NOT submitted by us

ScryOrchard.consumed_by: ORCHARD (contracts/town.env) - the v3 LP staking seasons
ScryOrchard.note: DEPLOYED WITH NO SEASON POSTED, which is the correct opening state - a season is a funded pot and its own operator act (RUNBOOK.md 2 7b: preflight with SEASON_POT for the <=10% reserve cap, then stewardMint -> approve -> createIncentive). rewardToken/npm/factory all IMMUTABLE and read back off chain: OBOL 0xA003af4A / NPM 0x73991a25 / factory 0x1f7d7550. The orchard NEVER mints - a season is funded up front or it does not exist - so this deploy moved no minter and is safe under the 2026-07-30 closing-act hold. Seasons pay OBOL, never MYRRH (SEASONS.md 4); the 2026-07-26 farm flip moved the GARDENER to MYRRH and left this alone.

ScryGacha.consumed_by: SCRY_GACHA + SCRY_GACHA_POOLS (meter/ecosystem.config.js on the deploy box) -> GET /gacha, GET /gacha/book, watchtower/gacha.html
ScryGacha.note: READ BACK OFF CHAIN at broadcast: feeSink 0xb474a952 (the dev wallet, operator 2026-07-30, on the standing 07-29 sentence for this class), drawDelay 100 IMMUTABLE, tollRate 0, owner = the deploy wallet. The first pool - StonkBrokers 0x539CdD04 - was OPENED in the same broadcast (openPool, one CALL after the CREATE): min backing 0.01 ETH, surcharge 1000 bps, standing bid 8500 bps FIXED. It holds no NFTs yet, so quote() reads (0x0,0) - an empty pool, not a broken one. Backing, price, fees and bids are native ETH between depositors and buyers; the SCRY toll rail is in the bytecode and DISARMED. drawDelay is 100 L2 blocks read through ArbSys(0x64), NOT Solidity's block.number - on Nitro that would be the parent chain's and would turn a ~10s reveal into ~20 minutes (RUNBOOK 0c).

ScryGranary:OBOL.consumed_by: GRANARY_OBOL (contracts/town.env) — the silo's drip, every season pot, and the cashier's posted daily cap
ScryGranary:OBOL.note: HOLDS OBOL's MINTER SLOT as of 2026-07-30 — read back off chain, OBOL.minter() == this. `spoils()` is the only immutable; steward is the deploy wallet and keeps setGrant / revokeGrant / stewardMint (UNCAPPED) / rotateMinterAway. Nothing was retired: rotateMinterAway hands the slot anywhere, including back to an EOA. The only terminal act is transferSteward, which is TWO-STEP (the successor must call acceptSteward) and which nothing in deploy_town.sh calls.

ScryGranary:MYRRH.consumed_by: GRANARY_MYRRH + the bare GRANARY alias (contracts/town.env) — the farm's crop
ScryGranary:MYRRH.note: HOLDS MYRRH's MINTER SLOT as of 2026-07-30. ⚠ A ScryGranary binds ONE token, so this and the OBOL one are NOT interchangeable — town.env's bare `GRANARY` alias names THIS (MYRRH) one, and RUNBOOK 7b/7c both warn that a stewardMint on the wrong granary mints the wrong coin. Steward is the deploy wallet.

ScryGardener.note: MYRRH's ONLY SOURCE (FARMING.md 3a) — until this, MYRRH was buy-only and every token of it had been hand-minted. pid 0 = the MYRRH/OBOL Garden SEED. ⚠ IMMUTABLE, no setter: unlockTime 1793238731 = 2026-10-29T01:52Z, the cliff 67% of every harvest locks until; and the halving SHAPE (every 4y, 10 halvings, a 40-year run). Adjustable forever: rewardPerSecond (era-0 base 6944444444444444 = 599 MYRRH/day), lockBps 6700, addPool, setAllocPoint. Its granary grant is 12,500 MYRRH/day and is SIZED BY THE CLIFF, not by emission (final tx 0x416838be…, read back off chain). It spent part of 2026-07-30 at 1,250 — the old '~2x era 0' justification died when era 0 was cut 6,000 -> 600 — and was set back the same day: the 2x ratio was never what binds it. `unlockTime` is. Only the immediate 33% (~198 MYRRH/day) is mintable while rewards lock; on the cliff ~36,120 MYRRH becomes claimable at once and claimLocked is clamped by this same cap, so 12,500 clears the lump in ~3 days against ~29 at 1,250. Nothing is lost at either — claimLocked re-credits the shortfall and zeroes before the call (the 2026-07-27 reentrancy fix) — so the only question was how long a farmer who already waited 90 days waits again. Cost: 0.06% of MYRRH's cap per day, and setGrant lowers immediately with no notice period.

ScrySilo.note: Bound to the OBOL granary, read back off chain. ⚠ IMMUTABLE: maxBreakBps 5000 — the seal-break burn at t=0. Grant read back at 250e18 OBOL/day, the posted rate; RUNBOOK 7d records a 10x-low 25e18 as the bug this replaced, where ~4 of every 5 harvested OBOL would silently become a stash IOU with nothing reverting. rewardPerSecond 1388888888888888 = ~120 OBOL/day, adjustable.
